force_capability_lab.name: Forces — a capability court
force_capability_lab.description: Two carried points apply thrust; a cake mortar launches hollow physical rings; a launch pad meets a moving platform; a hinged pole falls; spring points collide; loose cubes cross a drag lane. Ordinary aftermath persists until an explicit reset.
force_capability_lab.qfep_connection: A known object gains a capacity. Release lets the environment participate; the next attempt inherits the aftermath. Pulling, resistance and drag can be read together without equating their meanings.
